ValidationRule.description: Prevents community users from changing their name. This will allow Community User names to always match Contact names.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( Profile.Id = '00ed00000019z5n' || Profile.Id = '00ed00000019z5s',
$User.ProfileId = '00ed00000019z5n' || $User.ProfileId = '00ed00000019z5s',
ISCHANGED( FirstName ) || ISCHANGED ( LastName) || ISCHANGED ( Email ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only System Administrators can change Community User Names or Emails. Please contact Salesforce.Support@asu.edu if you need to make a change.
